<subject>Meridian Law & Advisory LLP?</subject>
<body>
Antony,

Cavendish Partners, on behalf of the Regulatory Affairs Committee, will be soliciting bids for compliance services.  We are currently contemplating limited advisory work, and would like to get a Non-Disclosure Agreement in place.  We would like to do a quick follow up in regards to the status of the NDA contract between yourselves and the Corporate Department.  If your legal department has any questions or concerns, please contact Dale Fletcher of Cavendish Partners at +44 7817 646361.

To address any credit concerns you may have, the department is currently preparing a complete credit package which we will forward to you upon its completion.

Again, please do not hesitate to call.

Thank You,
Rachael Lewis
Coordinator

10 Fleet Street, London EC4A 2BU
